current_status_2026_05_24: Public repository for Coptic SCRIPTORIUM corpora releases; data available in CoNLL-U, relANNIS, PAULA XML, TEI XML, and TreeTagger SGML; annotation quality metadata includes automatic, checked, and gold.
license_or_rights: CC-BY 3.0 or 4.0 unless otherwise indicated; file-level licenses and exceptions apply.
reported_scope: Multiple Coptic corpora with possible duplicate, redundant, and parallel-witness texts.
usable_fields_or_formats: CoNLL-U; relANNIS; PAULA XML; TEI XML; TreeTagger SGML; metadata in PAULA XML, relANNIS, and meta.json.

admissible_use: Estimate what continuity infrastructure contributes when evidence is much richer than IVC.
non_admissible_use: Claiming Coptic-style translation accuracy is reachable for IVC from current evidence.

source_name: Mycenean Linear B sequences - series D

reported_scope: 2,565 sequences: first 513 real Series D tablet sequences, next 725 augmented sequences, remaining 1,327 duplicates.
usable_fields_or_formats: Symbol sequences in Samples.txt; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.7404653; file md5 0c9b9190b86840c82cafdbf4f4b8c827.
first_pass_role: First known-script scarcity comparator to run.
exclusions_or_caveats: Use only first 513 real sequences for clean baseline; exclude augmented and duplicate rows unless testing them explicitly; hide Mycenaean readings and translations.
next_acquisition_action: Download and hash Samples.txt; parse row ranges; create E5.3a Linear B scarcity baseline with structural-only tasks.
admissible_use: Known-script ceiling for A2 structural recovery under short-sequence, no-translation conditions.
non_admissible_use: Using known Greek readings, lexical values, or translations to inflate IVC-like performance.

source_type: GitHub data-prep repository plus Hugging Face dataset
current_status_2026_05_24: GitHub reports version 1 dataset with CSV fields id, glyphs, transliteration, glyph_names, period, genre; arXiv paper submitted 2026-02-25 reports the same dataset and open code/data.
usable_fields_or_formats: CSV fields id, glyphs, transliteration, glyph_names, period, genre; Hugging Face dataset link in README.
first_pass_role: Second-stage large administrative comparator after Linear B.
exclusions_or_caveats: Very large; transliteration labels are interpretations and must be hidden for IVC-like tests; source is current/new and must be revision-pinned.

admissible_use: Stress-test IVC methods against a large deciphered administrative corpus under label-hiding.
non_admissible_use: Treating transliteration performance or known Sumerian readings as available evidence for IVC.
